nom: Lasko Ceramic Tower Heater with Remote Control
description: The Lasko Elite Collection Digital Ceramic Tower Full Room Heater, CT22495, with Remote Control is the perfect addition to any home during the cold winter months. This heater features 25% wider oscillation, providing full room coverage and ensuring that every corner of your room is warmed up. The safety features on this heater have been reimagined to provide maximum protection to you and your loved ones. The safety rollover design helps to prevent the heater from falling on its grill, while the child lock ensures that curious little hands cannot accidentally change the settings. The tip-over switch automatically shuts off the heater if it accidentally falls over. The touch sensing controls on this heater are not only easy to use but also provide an auto-dimming digital read-out, making it easy to monitor the temperature and settings. The heater has three heat settings: Low (750 W), Med (1300 W), and High (1500W), allowing you to choose the perfect temperature for your room. The 12-hour auto-off timer can be set in 30-minute increments (up to 2 hrs), providing a convenient way to turn off the heater when you are away or when you fall asleep. The AutoEco thermostat maintains room temperature while using less energy, making this heater an eco-friendly and cost-effective option for your home. The multi-function remote control provides added convenience and ease of use, allowing you to control the heater from anywhere in the room. The remote control also has on-board storage, making it easy to keep track of and preventing it from getting lost. The batteries for the remote control are included. Comes fully assembled with a 3-year limited warranty. nom: Hamilton Beach FlexBrew 2-Way Single Serve Coffee Maker
description: No two coffee drinkers are the same so when you make coffee at home, the flexibility to customize how and what you brew is key. From fresh grounds to K-Cup®* pods, the FlexBrew® 2-Way Coffee Maker gives you the options to please fans of all types of coffees. TWO WAYS TO BREW. Brew a full pot using your favorite grounds on the carafe side, or make a cup for yourself using a K-Cup®* pod or grounds on the single-serve side with this 2-in-1 coffee maker. nom: Ninja 14-in-1 Double Oven with FlexDoor
description: Meet the Ninja® Double Oven, the countertop oven that unlocks the power of two ovens in the counter space of one. Only Ninja has the FlexDoor™ that creates 2 separate ovens so you can cook 2 meals, 2 ways at different temperatures and cooking times. Use just the Top Rapid Oven for quick snacks, sides, and sheet pan meals—or the Bottom Convection & Air Fry Oven for larger roasts, bakes, or air frying up to 6 lbs of wings. You can also sync both independent ovens to cook a full course meal that finishes cooking at the same time with Smart Finish™ technology. While your meal cooks, FlavorSeal technology prevents flavor crossover between ovens. Two oven cavities in one eliminate back-to-back cooking for 65% faster meal-making than your traditional oven so you can put your wall oven out of business. Plus, this countertop dual oven features 14 cooking functions for the ultimate versatility. Accessories Included: 1800W Double Oven Unit (2) Sheet Pans Air Fry Basket (2) Wire Racks Removeable Crumb Tray Roast Tray Ninja NeverStick™ Premium 9" Round Cake Pan Ninja NeverStick™ Premium 8" Square Cake Pan Recipe Book Product Features: Flexdoor™ creates two separate ovens. Access just the top for quick meals and snacks, or open the full door so you can cook 2 meals, 2 ways on the top and bottom. FlavorSeal Technology prevents smells from crossing between ovens, so your flavors stay separate. SmartFinish™ technology syncs both independent ovens to cook 2 meals, 2 different ways that finish at the same time. Eliminate back-to-back cooking for 65% faster meal-making than your traditional oven. 14 cooking functions. Bake, broil, reheat, keep warm, bagel, toast, and cookies in the Top Rapid Oven. Air fry, convection bake, pizza, air roast, whole roast, dehydrate, and proof in the Bottom Convection & Air Fry Oven. Family-sized capacity to feed up to 8 people. Two independent ovens let you cook a meal for the kids and a separate meal for the parents at the same time for easy family dinners. Sync both ovens to cook a full meal that finishes cooking at the same time with Smart Finish™ technology. For maximum aroma and flavor retention nothing beats the Infinity Conical Burr Grinder series.  The Metal Die-Cast Housing makes the grinder quieter, has less friction and is twice as heavy then non-metal grinders.  Computer controlled special grinding heads cut the angles and shapes of the steel burrs to within 0.1 mm precision (1/250 of 1 inch). Burrs are produced as matched pairs and are hand-assembled in Switzerland for precise fit. The multiple gear motor produces the slowest grinding action (< 450 rpm) resulting in highest precision grinding from Turkish fine to percolator coarse. Product Features: Heavy-duty brushed Metal die-cast housing Extremely wide range from Turkish fine to coarse for all kinds of coffee preparation Clearly marked fineness settings: 4 extra fine, fine, regular, & coarse; total of 16 settings Commercial grade, solid conical steel burrs w/advanced cutting design for high precision grinding Gear reduction motor grinds slow w/reduced noise & little static build-up Slowest grinding speed in its class creates less friction & heat build up preserving max aroma & flavor in any grind setting Safety lock system Upper conical burr removable for easy cleaning Tight fitting ground coffee container (holds up to 4 oz. of ground coffee) See through bean container holds up to 8.8 oz. of beans Timer can be set to grind from 5 to 60 seconds Pulse grinding possible Elegant, timeless and user-friendly design Cleaning brush and measuring scoop included Dimensions & More Info: 10.8” L x 5.4” W x 7.7” H; Weight: 6.1 lbs. Watt/Volt/Hertz: 100W, 120V, 60Hz UL Listed 1 Year Limited Warranty for Household Use Made in China Warranty: 1-year limited warranty for Household use For further product information please call Jura-Capresso at 1-800-767-3554.

nom: JURA E6 Automatic Coffee Machine, Piano
description: Even more aroma for even more enjoyment The Professional Aroma Grinder helps to create the perfect coffee that is second to none. Thanks to perfected grinder geometry, the quality of the grind is more consistent, and this performance is maintained over its entire service life. This optimizes aroma extraction and achieves an aroma increase of 12.2% compared to conventional grinders. Discover completely new sides to your favorite coffee specialty. Cappuccino made to perfection With the proven Easy Cappuccino function, you can enjoy superb cappuccino at the touch of a button. The milk nozzle, which was specially developed for cappuccino, ensures uniquely soft, fine milk foam that perfectly complements the coffee and promises true perfection. The ultimate solution for cappuccino lovers. Perfection made easy The clearly presented 2.8" color display, six ideally placed buttons and an intuitive operating concept enable convenient operation of the E6, whether you want simple coffee preparation, to set individual preferences or use the self-explanatory cleaning functions. The E6 is also compatible with J.O.E.®, which allows you to prepare specialty coffees, set and store personal preferences and easily send your guests' coffee orders directly to the coffee machine from your smartphone. Sustainable design With its quiet elegance, the design of the E6 reflects the unique technology hidden behind its timeless exterior. The linear geometry with sophisticated chrome accents ensures a distinct visual that focuses uncompromisingly on first-class coffee and blends harmoniously into any décor. Both in terms of the selection of specialties and its design, the E6 purposely avoids any excess that could distract from its true essence: The perfect cup of coffee. Accessories Included: Jura Starter Kit User Manual Product Features: Professional Aroma Grinder grinds fresh, whole beans and ensures more aromatic coffee through more consistent grinding. Grinder is adjustable.. The advanced eighth-generation brewing unit with 3D brewing technology ensures ultimate flavor and aroma. JURA's exclusive Pulse Extraction Process, also known as P.E.P.®, ensures the optimum extraction time by pulsing the hot water through the ground coffee at the optimum frequency for the amount of water. Fine Foam Frother prepares fine, compact milk foam making it possible to prepare trend specialties to professional barista standards. The milk system should be cleaned daily using the included container when preparing milk specialties. The milk system can also be rinsed intermittently in between preparations. This versatile machine can also deliver hot water on demand for tea or Americano, with three programmable hot water temperatures. Holds 10 oz. of fresh, whole beans and has an aroma preservation lid to keep beans fresh to guarantee a fresh cup of coffee every time. The 64 oz. water tank is front loading and has an RFID chip which communicates with the CLEARYL Smart filter and advises the uses when it’s time to be replaced. The CLEARYL Smart filter maintains water purity as part of the brand’s commitment to maximizing quality and taste. Programmable Color Display Height Adjustable Dual Coffee Spouts Dimensions & More Info: 11 in W x 13.8 in H x 17.6 in D 20 Lbs 230 V | 1450 W Made in Portugal Warranty: 2 Year limited warranty For product related questions please contact “Jura” at 1-800-220-5701

nom: Philips 800 Series Automatic Espresso Machine
description: Two delicious coffees from fresh beans, with ease, thanks to the intuitive touch display. Enjoy the delicious taste and aroma of coffee from fresh beans, at the perfect temperature, thanks to our intelligent brewing system. The classic milk frother allows you to create a silky-smooth cappuccino or latte macchiato with ease. Accessories Included: Grease tube Measuring scoop Water hardness test strip Product Features: Coffee from fresh beans – easily make delicious coffee drinks from fresh beans, exactly the way you like it, with the touch of a button. Automatic descaling for your convenience - it is easy to clean and maintain your coffee machine with the automatic program which notifies when you have to descale it. You can adjust the frequency of this procedure to match the water hardness at home. Adjust aroma strength and quantity via My Coffee Choice - adjust the strength and quantity of your beverage with the My Coffee Choice menu. Easily choose from three different settings to suit your preferences. Dishwasher safe parts for your convenience - for your convenience, you can put the milk system, drip tray and the coffee ground container in the dishwasher. This will save time and ensure a hygienic cleaning. Easy cleaning thanks to fully removable brew group - the brew group is the heart of every fully automatic coffee machine and should be cleaned regularly. The removable brew group allows you to clean it thoroughly just by rinsing it under the tap. Easy selection of your coffee with intuitive touch display - The irresistible taste and aroma of coffee from fresh beans is just one touch away. Our intuitive touch display allows you to easily select your favorite coffee. 20,000 cups of finest coffee with durable ceramic grinders - Bring out the full flavor of your coffee with our hard-wearing ceramic grinder. Our sharp-edged grinders extract the best aroma and flavor from your beans. Made from 100% ceramic material which ensures they last for at least 20,000 cups. Easily adjust to your taste with 12-step grinder levels - our durable ceramic grinders can be adjusted in 12 steps, so you can turn your beans into anything from ultra-fine powder to coarse grindings. The perfect temperature, aroma and crema cup after cup – the Aroma extract system intelligently strikes the optimum balance between brewing temperature and aroma extraction by keeping the water temperature between 194°F and 208°F, while regulating the water flow rate, so you can enjoy delicious coffees. Up to 5,000 cups without descaling thanks to AquaClean water filter* – by changing the filter after being prompted by the machine, you will not need to descale your machine for up to 5,000 cups**, while enjoying clear and purified water. *AquaClean filter compatible; not included. Sold separately. **Based on 8 filters replacement as indicated by the machine. Actual number of cups depends on selected coffee varieties, rinsing and cleaning patterns. Dimensions & More Info: Type of material made out of: plastic, stainless steel 9.69 in. x 17.05 in. x 14.61 in. 16.5lbs 1500 W Designed in Italy, Made in Romania For product related questions please contact Versuni at +1-833-737-1212; Monday to Friday: 09:00am - 06:00pm EST

nom: Keurig K-Supreme Plus Special Edition Single Serve Coffee Maker, with 18 K-Cup Pods
description: Elevate your everyday coffee experience to delicious new heights with the Keurig® K-Supreme Plus® Special Edition Single Serve coffee maker. Innovative MultiStream Technology™ saturates the grounds more evenly to extract* more flavor and aroma, so you can enjoy an exceptionally flavorful experience in every cup. Programmable preferences for up to 3 users, customizable settings for strength and temperature, and a sleek stainless-steel metal wrap make it a supremely striking standout in any kitchen. Accessories Included: 18 K-Cup® Pods, Water Filter + Handle, My K-Cup® Universal Reusable Coffee Filter Product Features: Programmable Favorites: Save individual brewing preferences for up to 3 users. Customize Your Cup: With 5 strengths and 5 temperature options, or make it iced by brewing hot over ice and enjoying cold Multiple Brew Sizes: Brew a 4, 6, 8, 10, or 12 oz. cup. 78 oz. Removable Reservoir: Allows you to brew up to 9 cups before having to refill, saving you time. Fast & Fresh-Brewed: Coffee made in minutes. Back-To-Back Brewing: Immediately brew a second cup, no need to wait for reheating. Travel Mug Friendly: Removable drip tray accommodates travel mugs up to 7” tall. Digital Display Screen: Just insert any K-Cup® pod and use the simple interface to brew a delicious cup. Compatible with the My K-Cup® Universal Reusable Coffee Filter: Brew your own ground coffee (sold separately). For great tasting coffee, keep your brewer running at peak performance by descaling your brewer every 3 months, or when the descale notification turns on. *Descaling kit not included. nom: Brita Hub Instant Powerful Countertop Water Filtration Device
description: The Brita Hub Instant Countertop Water Filtration Device powered by Hamilton Beach uses Brita's best filter ever to reduce 70+ contaminants. The Brita Hub™ filter reduces 70+ contaminants including lead, chlorine, microplastics and more.* GREAT TASTE, LESS WASTE: Get great tasting water without the waste. By switching to this Brita water filter dispenser, your family can save money and replace around 1800 single-use plastic water bottles a year.** CONVENIENT, EASY SETUP IN MINUTES: No installation or tools required. Simply insert the filter, fill the 12 cup removable reservoir on the countertop water filter, plug in and flush the system twice to begin enjoying. Simply choose between 12 oz. and 20 oz. presets, or use manual mode to fill your glass or bottle. nom: Hamilton Beach Professional Super Chute Easy Clean Juice Extractor
description: Make fresh, healthy juice in seconds with the Hamilton Beach® Professional Super Chute™ Easy Clean Juice Extractor. The 3.5" Super Chute virtually eliminates pre-cutting to save time and the Easy Sweep™ tool cuts strainer cleaning time in half. Accessories Included: Easy Sweep cleaning tool 34 ounce pitcher with foam separator on its lid Product Features: MAKE FRESH, HEALTHY JUICE IN SECONDS. Juicing at home is a fast, fun way to get your daily nutrients. Make juice with classic produce such as oranges, apples and carrots, or create on-trend juice blends with celery, ginger, kale, spinach and beets. SAVES TIME — 3.5" SUPER CHUTE. The extra-large feed chute virtually eliminates pre-cutting and fits a whole apple, peeled orange or handful of kale. You'll enjoy fast, continuous juicing and the large pulp bin lets you juice more and empty less. EASY TO CLEAN — PATENTED EASY SWEEP™ CLEANING TOOL. The Easy Sweep™ cleaning tool sweeps the strainer clean in one simple motion, cutting the strainer cleaning time of this juicer machine in half. The BPA-free pitcher, lid, pulp bin, cleaning tool and pusher go in the dishwasher for fast, easy cleanup. MAKES 16 OZ. OF JUICE IN JUST 10 SECONDS. Why buy juice when you can make your own in 10 seconds flat? The powerful 1100 watt dual-speed motor of this juice extractor gives you faster juicing and provides maximum juice yield. ENJOY DELICIOUS, FOAM-FREE JUICE. The large 34 oz. pitcher of this fruit and vegetable juicer has a froth separator on its lid so you'll pour clear, foam-free juice into your glass. Dimensions & More Info: Type of material made from: Plastic and metal 9.5” L x 16.7” W x 17.2” H 15.5 lbs 1100-Watts Made in China Warranty: Can be found on pg-12 of the Use and Care Guide. Parts/Labor: 5-year limited warranty

nom: FoodSaver Preserve Vacuum Sealing System Starter Kit with Bags and Rolls
description: Keep food fresh up to 5x longer then ordinary storage methods with the FoodSaver Preserve Vacuum Sealing System. This vacuum sealer machine uses innovative technologies to remove air and create an airtight seal, helping to prevent freezer burn, preserve freshness, and save you money. Choose from 4 different sealing modes for maximum versatility: Dry, Moist, Pulse, and Sous Vide. Built-in roll storage and cutter bar let you easily create custom-size bags, and built-in bag alignment plus an extra wide sealing strip helps cut down on bag waste. The included FoodSaver® Handheld Sealer is designed to work with FoodSaver® vacuum zipper bags, containers, canisters, and all other FoodSaver® accessories including wine stoppers, jar sealers and the Quick Marinator, without requiring additional adapters, or parts. Ideal for storing refrigerated and pantry foods, keeping them fresh longer compared to unwrapped foods. The stylish matte black finish adds a modern touch to any kitchen, and built-in cord storage keeps countertops clean and tidy when the sealer is not in use. This starter kit includes a six-month supply of bags and rolls so you can start sealing right away! Save more with a FoodSaver Vacuum Sealer, and get the most out of your food today.
